facts.fact: LINX announced that LINX Mombasa, a multi-site IXP in the iColo MBA1 and MBA2 data centres in Mombasa, is ready for business, after LINX Nairobi launched just over 12 months earlier.
LINX states LINX Mombasa in Mombasa is a second exchange point in service in Kenya alongside LINX Nairobi in Nairobi, the first IXP with a physical presence in both cities.
